description: Jackson, MS – In case you missed it, MS NOW political reporter Nnamdi Egwuonwu just wrote a new story spotlighting District Attorney Scott Colom's U.S. Senate campaign and his path to victory this November as Mississippi voters grow increasingly angry with incumbent Hyde-Smith’s record of raising costs for Mississippi families, supporting the Iran War, and blocking the release of the Epstein files.
